name: sele-security-suite
description: Orchestrates the SIEM and Argus frontends/backends

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SIEM-FE,ARGUS-FE,SIEM-BE,ARGUS-BE -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "cd siem/frontend && npm run dev" "cd argus/frontend && npm run dev -- --port 5174" "cd siem/backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000" "cd argus/backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5000"
